title: Not every EM field is conscious

statements.text: Just as not all matter is alive, not all electromagnetic fields are conscious. A conscious field must be complex enough to encode complex computations and have the causal power to pass thoughts on, which the field of a toaster lacks, so the theory does not predict panpsychism.

sources.quote: though consciousness may be made of EM fields, not all EM fields are conscious
The cemi field theory thereby does not predict panpsychism for such objects.
